description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grant [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Thief Mode I (Zidane)] and [Thief Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Thief Mode I (Zidane)
description.text: Thief abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Thief abilities trigger 2 additional times, critical chance =25%/50%/75%/100% for equipped Thief abilities after casting 1/2/3/4+ Thief abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Dual Awoken Thief Mode II (Zidane)] and [Zidane Trance]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Thief Mode II (Zidane)

description.name: Buff Wind 20% (5s)
description.text: Increases Wind damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Zidane Trance
